title: The Language of the coast road
author: Edmund Okonkwo
blurb: Wren Yarrow, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
